title: Deepfake Scams and Fakes
about: Spot the red flags of a faked voice or video, and check who is really there.

cards.prompt: A call from an unknown number sounds just like your grandma.

steps.text: "I've lost my purse. Send me money now, and don't worry your parents." What do you do?

choices.text: Send the money: it's her voice
choices.consequence: Voices can be copied with AI. Money sent to a scammer is usually gone for good.

choices.text: Say you'll call her back, and hang up
choices.consequence: Good: hanging up stops the pressure. Now check.

choices.text: Keep chatting to find out more
choices.consequence: Scammers are good at talking, so the longer you stay on, the more they push. It's safer to hang up.

steps.text: How do you check it was really her?

choices.text: Call Grandma on the number you already have
choices.consequence: She answers at home, perfectly fine. It was a scam, and you stopped it.

choices.text: Call back the number that just rang
choices.consequence: That number belongs to the caller, so they would just answer again. Use the number you already have.

choices.text: Tell a trusted adult what happened
choices.consequence: An adult can call Grandma on her real number with you, and help report the scam.

cards.hint: A familiar voice can be copied. Is there a way to reach the real Grandma that the caller can't fake?
cards.explanation: A new number, hurry and secret money are red flags. Hang up, then check on the number you already have.

cards.prompt: Scammers grab a few seconds of your voice. What can they make?

options.text: A fake voice like yours, saying anything they type
Nothing, because copying a voice needs hours of recordings
options.nudge: That was true years ago. Today AI can copy a voice from a short clip.

options.text: Only that same clip, played back word for word
options.nudge: AI doesn't just replay the clip. It learns how you sound and makes new sentences.

options.text: A robot voice that anyone would spot straight away
options.nudge: Copies can sound very real. That's why you check the number, not the voice.

cards.explanation: AI can learn a voice from a short clip and make it say new things. So a familiar voice alone proves nothing.
cards.hint: Think about Grandma's call. Did the voice sound like a recording, or like her talking?

cards.title: Fake voices and faces
cards.body:
AI can copy a voice from real recordings, sometimes just a few seconds of video posted online: a **voice clone**. A faked video or picture is a **deepfake**. You can't always tell by looking or listening.

The red flags still work: **hurry**, **keep it secret**, **money, gift cards or codes**, and **a new number**.

**What to do:** hang up or stop replying. Contact them on the number **you already have**, or ask a trusted adult.

items.label: Don't tell Mum, just send it
Buy gift cards and send the codes
See you at practice on Saturday
Can you bring my jumper home?

cards.hint: Look for the four tricks: hurry, secrets, money or codes, and a new number.
cards.nudge: Check each message for pressure to hurry, to keep a secret, to send money or codes, or a new number.
cards.explanation: Rushing, secrets, gift cards or codes, and a new number are red flags, whoever it seems to be from. Plans and favours are normal.

cards.prompt: A caller fails your secret family safe word, and rushes you.

options.text: Hang up, and call him on the number you already have
Keep going: he's probably just forgotten it in a panic
options.nudge: A voice can be copied, so a forgotten word plus hurry is exactly when to check another way.

options.text: Give him a clue about the word so he can remember it
options.nudge: A clue could hand the word to a scammer. Reach him another way instead.

cards.hint: A safe word is a check a copied voice can't pass. If it fails, how else can you reach him?
cards.explanation: No safe word plus hurry means hang up and call his usual number. Never give the safe word away, even as a clue.

cards.prompt: A video message from an account with your coach's face.

steps.text: "Send me a photo of you in your uniform. Keep it between us." It could be a deepfake. What do you do?

choices.consequence: "Keep it between us" is a red flag, even from someone you know. A real coach would not ask for secrets.

choices.text: Don't reply; tell a trusted adult
choices.consequence: An adult can check with the real coach. Secrets and photo requests are red flags, whatever the face.

choices.text: Ask for another video to prove it
choices.consequence: A deepfake can make another video. Check another way, through a trusted adult or the coach's usual contact.

cards.hint: Look past the face. Which red flag is in the message itself?
cards.explanation: Real face or fake, keep it between us is a red flag. Don't reply, and tell a trusted adult who can check.

cards.prompt: Someone made a fake picture of you and wants money.

steps.text: It's not your fault. What do you do first?

choices.text: Pay so it never gets shared
choices.consequence: Paying usually leads to more demands, not fewer. Never pay.

choices.text: Tell a trusted adult, and save evidence
choices.consequence: Good. Screenshot the messages and account as evidence, never the image itself.

choices.text: Send it to a friend to warn them
choices.consequence: Don't pass it on, even to show someone. Tell a trusted adult.

choices.text: The app, eSafety, and the ACCCE
choices.consequence: Report to the app and eSafety (esafety.gov.au/report). Under 18, tell the ACCCE too.

choices.text: Just the app: it's only a fake
choices.consequence: A fake is serious too. eSafety can help take it down.

choices.text: Nowhere: you might get in trouble
choices.consequence: You won't be in trouble for asking. Reporting is how it stops.

cards.hint: Look at who to report to, and what changes when you're under 18 and threatened.
cards.explanation: Report to the app and eSafety (esafety.gov.au/report), and under 18, the ACCCE (accce.gov.au/report) too. It's never your fault.

cards.prompt: A friend's video call asks for your sign-in code. What's best?

options.text: Don't send it; check on their usual number
Send it: the face and voice match
options.nudge: Faces and voices can be faked with AI. Reach your friend another way.

options.text: Ask why it's urgent, then decide
options.nudge: A scammer can always invent a good reason, and hurry is a red flag.

cards.hint: A face and voice can be faked. What can't a scammer fake?
cards.explanation: A deepfake can copy a face and voice, but it can't answer on your friend's usual number. Sign-in codes are never safe to share.

cards.title: Recap
cards.body:
- AI can fake voices and faces: check on a number you already have.
- A fake of you is never your fault: tell, save evidence, report.
- **Try this:** agree a family safe word tonight.

Talk any time: **Kids Helpline** 1800 55 1800 (up to 25) or **Lifeline** 13 11 14.

**Next:** who to tell, and where to go, when something's wrong.
